T12.1.ref: CREATE VIEW suv_timeline AS SELECT 'gate' AS source, ts, gate AS place FROM gate_log WHERE vehicle_no = '26 BH 4471 EX' UNION ALL SELECT 'toll', ts, plaza FROM toll_crossings WHERE vehicle_no = '26 BH 4471 EX' UNION ALL SELECT 'tower', ts, tower_area FROM tower_pings WHERE device_owner = 'Dev Arora';

T12.2.ref: SELECT * FROM suv_timeline WHERE source <> 'tower' ORDER BY ts;

T12.3.ref: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'view';

T12.5.ref: SELECT payer, payee, amount FROM label_payments WHERE amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM label_payments);

traps.sql: SELECT payer, payee, amount FROM label_payments WHERE amount > AVG(amount);
SELECT payer, payee, amount FROM label_payments WHERE amount > (SELECT amount, payment_id FROM label_payments);

T12.5b.ref: SELECT * FROM contracts WHERE artist_name = 'Tara Sen';

T12.6.ref: SELECT payment_id, payer, payee, amount - (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM label_payments) AS above_avg FROM label_payments;

traps.sql: SELECT payment_id, payer, payee, amount - (SELECT AVG(amount), MAX(amount) FROM label_payments) AS above_avg FROM label_payments;

T12.7.ref: SELECT payment_id, CASE WHEN amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM label_payments) THEN 'Above Average' ELSE 'Below Average' END AS tag FROM label_payments;

T12.8.ref: SELECT payee, AVG(monthly_total) FROM (SELECT payee, strftime('%m', ts) AS month, SUM(amount) AS monthly_total FROM label_payments GROUP BY payee, month) AS monthly_totals GROUP BY payee;

T12.9.ref: SELECT lsn, txn_id, entry_type, data_item, old_value, new_value, user_name, ts FROM txn_log WHERE txn_id IN ('T7', 'T9') OR entry_type = 'CRASH' ORDER BY lsn;

T12.10.ref: SELECT txn_id FROM txn_log WHERE entry_type = 'START' EXCEPT SELECT txn_id FROM txn_log WHERE entry_type = 'COMMIT';
